recipe.visualDefinition: A portrait of a young man holding a vintage camera, viewed through a grid of 35mm film contact sheet frames. The composition uses black film borders with technical markings to fragment a single large image into a tiled mosaic, overlaid with casual, marker-style handwriting.
coreVisualRelationships: Grid-based fragmentation of a singular subject
Contrast between technical film markings and organic handwriting
Interaction between the subject's gaze and the camera lens within the frames
Diagonal red arrow pointing from title text to the subject's face
coreInvariants: Black film strip borders with frame numbers and film stock labels
White background visible behind the film grid

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A close-up portrait occupies the central and right two-thirds of the grid, with hands and camera occupying the left two-thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's right eye and the camera lens, positioned in adjacent frames.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left title, follows the red arrow down to the subject's face, then moves through the grid to the camera lens.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: High-key white space at the top-left corner and edges of the frame.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Natural skin tones and metallic camera textures against high-contrast black and white graphic elements.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to black, white, red, and naturalistic photographic tones

letterConstructionRules: Varying stroke weights suggesting felt-tip marker
Mix of uppercase and lowercase within words
characterSpecificRedesigns: Title text features a slight slant and elongated strokes
Film markings use a monospaced, technical sans-serif style
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Technical monospaced type paired with expressive, messy handwriting.

preserve: The red color for the main title
The black film strip grid structure
avoid: Perfectly clean, digital fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the raw, handwritten feel of the title
Approximates the technical film stock markings

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key portrait of a person holding a vintage 35mm camera to their face, then overlay a grid of black 35mm film strips with frame numbers and 'KODAK' style technical text in white. Ensure the portrait is visible through the frame windows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, hand-written title in red marker at the top, slightly tilted. Draw a rough red arrow pointing from the title down into one of the film frames. Add smaller hand-written credits at the top and bottom corners.

verificationChecks: Grid aligns to standard 35mm film proportions
Handwriting looks organic and not like a repeated font
Red arrow has a sketchy, hand-drawn quality
Film markings are legible but small

adjustableVariables: Amount of white space at the edges
mustRedesign: Specific brand names like 'KODAK' or 'T MY'
Exact handwriting signature of the original artist

mustAchieve: Clear visual hierarchy despite the grid

postGenerationChecks: Does the grid feel like a physical contact sheet?
Is the red title the primary focal point?
Is the portrait recognizable through the fragmentation?
Are the technical film markings present on every horizontal border?
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a central photographic subject and slice it into a 3x4 grid using black film strip borders. Use white technical monospaced text for the borders and vibrant red hand-lettering for the main title and directional cues.
